title: Nehemiah Mourns Jerusalem and Prays for Mercy
summary_text: Nehemiah hears that the remnant in Judah suffers disgrace and that Jerusalem's walls and gates are ruined. He weeps, fasts, and prays to the God who keeps His covenant of loving devotion. He confesses his own family's sins along with Israel's failure to keep God's commandments. Recalling God's promise to gather His people if they return to Him, Nehemiah asks Him to hear the people He redeemed. As the king's cupbearer, he asks for success and mercy before the king.
